subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Sita was ______ to find out what had happened at the neighbour’s place that morning.
solution: The correct answer is '**curious**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word "**curious**" means eager to know or learn something. (उत्सुक) • Sita was eager or curious to find out what had happened at the neighbor’s place. • The other options: "**eccentric**," "**odd**," and "**peculiar**" do not fit the context as appropriately. ​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'. **Complete Sentence:** *Sita was curious__ to find out what had happened at the neighbour’s place that morning.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Eccentric (सनकी)**: means unconventional and slightly strange. • **Odd (अजीब)**: means different from what is usual or expected; strange. • **Peculiar (अजीब)**: means strange or odd; unusual. 34:T2325,
